description.en: Send the form or call. We tell you within a day whether we are free.

description.en: An hour at our Bole office. We listen, then show you ideas and an honest budget.
description.am: በቦሌ ቢሯችን አንድ ሰዓት። እናዳምጥዎታለን፤ ከዚያም ሐሳቦችንና ትክክለኛ በጀት እናሳይዎታለን።

description.en: You approve the design and the suppliers. We handle every call and payment date.
description.am: ንድፉንና አቅራቢዎቹን እርስዎ ያጸድቃሉ። ስልኩንና የክፍያ ቀኑን ሁሉ እኛ እንከታተላለን።

description.en: We arrive first and leave last. You only look after your guests.
description.am: ቀድመን ደርሰን መጨረሻ እንወጣለን። እርስዎ እንግዶችዎን ብቻ ያስተናግዳሉ።

quote.en: On the morning of our wedding I had nothing to do but get dressed. I still don't know what went wrong that day, and that is exactly the point.
quote.am: በሠርጋችን ጠዋት ከመልበስ በቀር የምሠራው አልነበረም። በዚያ ቀን ምን ችግር እንደተፈጠረ እስከ ዛሬ አላውቅም፤ የፈለግነውም ይኸው ነበር።

heading.en: A small team that knows the customs

body.en:
Fikir Events is five planners and designers who take a few events each month, so every family gets the same two faces from first meeting to last dance.

We know how a shimgilna is opened, when the coffee should be poured and how many cars a melse needs. You will not have to explain it twice.
body.am:
ፍቅር ኢቨንትስ አምስት አዘጋጆችና ዲዛይነሮች ያሉት ቡድን ነው። በወር ጥቂት ዝግጅት ብቻ ስለምንቀበል እያንዳንዱ ቤተሰብ ከመጀመሪያው ቀጠሮ እስከ መጨረሻው ጭፈራ ሁለት የሚያውቃቸውን ሰዎች ያገኛል።

ሽምግልና እንዴት እንደሚከፈት፣ ቡናው መቼ እንደሚቀዳ፣ ለመልስ ስንት መኪና እንደሚያስፈልግ እናውቃለን። ደጋግመው ማስረዳት አይጠበቅብዎትም።

alt.en: A coffee ceremony: a jebena pouring into small cups while incense smokes in a clay burner
alt.am: የቡና ሥነ ሥርዓት፤ ከጀበና ወደ ስኒዎች ቡና ሲቀዳ፣ ዕጣን በማጨሻ ሲጨስ

points.en: One planner and one designer for each event

points.en: Every supplier's price shown to you as it is

intro.en: Tell us the day and the size of the event. We answer within one working day, and the first meeting is free.
